title: Block Breaker
description: A neon brick-breaking arcade game with smooth physics. Break all the glowing blocks with your paddle and ball. Each row scores higher points, and the ball speeds up as you progress. How many levels can you clear?
short_description: Neon brick-breaking arcade. Bounce the ball, break blocks, score points!
controls_keyboard: Arrow keys or A/D to move paddle. Click or press any key to launch ball.
controls_gamepad: Left stick to move paddle. A button to launch.
